name: maya-classroom
description: Maya Classroom — Plataforma de aulas virtuales multiempresa (Angular 22 + NestJS 11 + MongoDB Atlas)

scripts.build: bun run build:shared && bun run build:api && bun run build:web
scripts.build:web: bun run build:shared && bun run --filter @maya/web build
scripts.dev: bun run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "bun run --filter @maya/api start:dev" "bun run --filter @maya/web start"
scripts.dev:api: bun run build:shared && bun run --filter @maya/api start:dev
scripts.dev:web: bun run build:shared && bun run --filter @maya/web start
